scope: One frozen shared baseline branched independently for each controlled E2 interleaving. Real Policy generation and semantic validation; scripted Observation/Evaluation and mock effect. No new E1 utility scoring.

stimuli.A-queue: Enqueue ordinary C/T2 during the first real Policy generation; attempt same-C start at reasoning, intent, returned effect and processed-result stages. T2 starts only after T1 settles, with formal scripted Observation and real Policy.
stimuli.B-external-before-commit: Independent Evaluation owner in C-external formally commits shared Belief r2 during Policy generation; exact r1 dependency explicitly requires current head. Expect CandidateStale, no intent, no silent rebase.
stimuli.C-external-before-effect: After committed Execute outcome and exact intent, independent Evaluation owner commits r2; expect NotOccurred before display, then process result and settle.

support_condition: All 15 branch runs satisfy checks with real Policy/validation. A/C must naturally choose Execute to cover effect boundaries; other choices leave coverage INCOMPLETE, never force or replace them.
falsifiers: Overlapping ordinary input processing within one conversation
Queued input leaks into frozen prior Context
External stale basis cannot be detected
Need learner-wide lock through model call
stop_rules: Stop on a failed invariant check or forbidden commit/effect.
Stop on HTTP 400/401/403/404/422 or three consecutive protocol/runtime failures.
Record incomplete or unrun cases; no retries, replacement runs or automatic additional batch.
excluded: User interruption and exception recovery UX
Production scheduler, threading and distributed transactions
